data.description:
## What
Create the arbiter agent definition and wire dispatch logic in runner.py.

## Changes
1. plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-arbiter.md: create with trinary output schema:
   - SUSTAIN_AT_SEVERITY | ACCEPT_DEFENSE | DOWNGRADE_TO_<severity>
   - Required subfields: reviewer_claimed_severity (verbatim), reviewer_severity_evidence (verbatim), named_rebuttal (cited-lines-backed)
2. runner.py: after collecting first_pass_findings, check for RESUSTAIN_OF findings with prior defense:
   - Load prior defenses via DSO_DEFENSE_STORE_PATH env var (path to JSONL file)
   - For each finding with relation=RESUSTAIN_OF: check if defense exists for that finding_id
   - If yes: dispatch code-reviewer-arbiter (model: claude-opus-4-7) with finding + defense as context
   - Arbiter ruling added to finding as arbiter_ruling field
3. Add 'code-reviewer-arbiter' to _REQUIRED_AGENT_IDS list in dispatch.py

## Acceptance Criteria
- test -f plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-arbiter.md
- grep -q 'RESUSTAIN_OF' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py
- RED tests from test_runner_arbiter.py pass GREEN
- make lint passes
data.title: GREEN: create code-reviewer-arbiter.md agent + dispatch in runner.py on RESUSTAIN_OF
